anchor_comparisons: The positive ordinal anchor is directionally comparable because actual earnings, cash conversion, and revisions strengthen together, although it is not an exact analogue.
The counter ordinal anchor remains relevant to durability risk, but current observed earnings and cash flow are materially stronger than its medium pattern.
disagreements: I place greater weight on observed earnings and cash conversion than on forecast fade alone, while retaining that fade as a duration constraint.
payload.rationale: Observed FY2025 and 1Q26 earnings, DRAM revenue and ASP expansion, more-than-doubled FY2025 HBM revenue, cash conversion, and forward revisions jointly support strong current economics. The evidence is issuer-wide or DRAM-wide rather than an HBM-only profit and free-cash-flow bridge, so the component ceiling is not warranted.
payload.why_not_higher: There is no disclosed HBM-only operating-profit or free-cash-flow bridge, and post-FY2026 decline estimates plus customer funding pressure limit durability.
payload.why_not_lower: A lower placement would underweight simultaneous observed profit, cash-flow, pricing, HBM-revenue-growth, and revision evidence.
